key.name: cross-copy
key.description: Copy the selection into the Cross Clipboard and send it to the other machine.

key.name: cross-cut
key.description: Cut the selection into the Cross Clipboard and send it to the other machine.

key.name: cross-paste
key.description: Paste the Cross Clipboard item into the focused window.

key.name: terminal-wm-classes
key.description: Windows whose WM class or app id matches one of these (case-insensitive) get Ctrl+Shift+C / Ctrl+Shift+V, because Ctrl+C interrupts programs in a terminal.

key.name: copy-wait-ms
key.description: How long an app gets to put its selection on the clipboard after the copy keystroke.

key.name: paste-restore-delay-ms
key.description: How long an app gets to read the pasted item before the normal clipboard is restored.
